identity.name: Tahiti Beach
identity.notes: Private island enclave of 26–29 luxury custom bayfront estates on Biscayne Bay in Coral Gables, nested within Cocoplum Phase 2 (Cocoplum Sec 2 Plat E) — a "gated community within a gated community" behind double guards/gates. Conceived in 1926 by Coral Gables founder George Merrick; the HOA is an active Florida not-for-profit corporation incorporated December 4, 1987 (entity #N23726). No fixed bridges; bridge-free deep-water bay access, with 18–21 waterfront estates holding private deep-water docks. Entry price reported at $15M+; management via FirstService Residential (305-255-3000, managertahitibeach@gmail.com).

fees.note: Detailed HOA fee schedule (monthly/quarterly/annual, transfer, capital contribution, special assessments) is not publicly available in reviewed sources; real estate listings reference quarterly HOA payments only. Exact amounts unknown. (HOA contact: 305-255-3000, managertahitibeach@gmail.com; managed by FirstService Residential.)

Initial HOA membership fee of $135,000 per community site 'Comparative Summary'. Community's own site; no HOA-published fee schedule found online. Confirm via FirstService Residential (305-255-3000, managertahitibeach@gmail.com).
HOA dues ~$9,000 per quarter (~$3,000/mo) per community site 'Comparative Summary'.
MLS A11861683 (26 Tahiti Beach Island Rd, active, upd. 3/12/2026): 'HOA FEE: $3,100/month; HOA FEE FREQ.: Quarterly'. Listing-site figure, lower confidence than HOA budget.
Same MLS listing: 'Association Fee: $9,300; Assoc Fee Freq.: Quarterly'. Consistent with $3,100/mo x 3; slightly above the ~$9,000/qtr community-site figure. Both reported, not reconciled.

Buyer blog estimates ~$1,500-$3,000+/month depending on property size and assessments; owners are part of the Cocoplum master association. Blog source; conflicts with higher figures above - reported separately.

amenities.detail: Private bayfront community beach on Biscayne Bay used for launching paddleboards and kayaks; direct deep-water bay access with no fixed bridges.
Guard-gated private island; described as a 'gated community within a gated community' behind the secure master gates of Cocoplum.
Access to Cocoplum's clubhouse, pool, fitness center, and other recreational facilities.
Fully staffed private marina with priority resident access.
18–21 waterfront/canal-front estates with private deep-water docks accommodating mid-size drafts; zero vertical height restrictions for tall-rig sailing yachts and sportfishers.
On-island private sandy bayfront beach for launching paddleboards, kayaks, and tenders.
Private Beach & Reserve on-island: sandy beach, tennis courts & quiet park, isolated from outside traffic.
Private quiet park/natural reserve on-island, isolated from outside traffic.
Priority resident access to fully staffed Cocoplum Yacht Club marina (on-island); 18-21 waterfront estates with private deep-water docks; no fixed bridges (unrestricted deep-water bay access).
Double-gated (manned gates within Cocoplum master gate) with 24/7 roving patrols; only 26-29 estates.
Tennis and pickleball courts plus private residents' beach park; double-gating (Cocoplum master gate plus Tahiti gate).
Access to Cocoplum's clubhouse, pool, fitness center and other recreational facilities.
Master Cocoplum Phase II (Islands of Cocoplum) amenity: 1,000 sqft gym in Clubhouse, top-of-line equipment, personal trainers, round-the-clock access. Tahiti Beach sits within Cocoplum Phase 2.
Master Cocoplum Phase II amenity: 60-foot climatized Olympic pool; registered swim coaches for kids/teens.
Master Cocoplum Phase II: Cocoplum Yacht Club marina, slips 40 ft to 120 ft T-Slips, protected from the bay; residents can purchase slips.
Master Cocoplum Phase II: Olympic-grade beach volleyball court, basketball court (plus kids' court), playground, sports field.
Master Cocoplum Phase II HOA: 24-hour security, Allied Security guards patrol, resident ID required for amenities; association fee covers security, landscaping, amenities, common-area maintenance.
MLS A11861683 community block: 'Association: Yes; Pets Allowed: Yes'. Detailed pet rules not published in sources read.

demographics.geography_level: ZIP Code 33143 (Census ACS 2024 5-yr; ZIP spans parts of Coral Gables, Glenvar Heights, South Miami, Kendall). No census geography for the 26-29-home enclave itself. Median HH income $83,008 and owner-occupancy 52.54% from same page. Alt ACS 2021 5-yr (uspopulation.org): pop 31,012, median age 40.8, median HH income $74,254. City of Coral Gables (censusflow, ACS 2024 5-yr): pop 49,802, median age 39.1. Not reconciled.
